selected_gap: Red Frank Deep Integrity checks on GitHub-hosted runners were ambiguous between actual executed Frank test failures and workflow/runner failures before Step 1.

hypothesis.primary: The observed hosted-runner red checks are PRE_STEP_TRANSPORT_FAILURE and therefore cannot be credited as Frank semantic/runtime test failures unless at least one test step actually executed.
hypothesis.strongest_counterhypothesis: The workflow or repository itself causes an immediate job failure that is still meaningfully attributable to Frank even though no step is reported as executed.
hypothesis.discriminator: Rerun a zero-dependency no-checkout control and the unchanged Deep Integrity job; compare job step execution. Independently inspect a self-hosted target-VPS validation receipt to ensure the accepted runner lane can execute current Frank discriminators.

executions.job_logic: zero-dependency shell printf only; no checkout and no project code

independent_self_hosted_evidence.limit: This is repository/static owner-fixed identity evidence on the accepted self-hosted lane, not boot/API/restart/stale-clone or whole Frank v0.1 acceptance.

external_current_status.observed: Actions reported operational at retrieval time
external_current_status.interpretation: No platform-wide Actions incident was visible; this does not rule out repository/account/runner-class/localized provisioning faults.

result.claim: A red GitHub Actions conclusion with no executed steps is insufficient evidence of a Frank test failure. Current observed hosted Deep Integrity reds must be classified as PRE_STEP_TRANSPORT_FAILURE until an execution receipt proves the test body ran.
architecture_test_delta: Acceptance/research receipts must record whether test steps actually executed before assigning semantic/runtime failure credit.
When hosted runner transport is ambiguous, use the accepted self-hosted Linux/X64 target-VPS lane for the same unchanged discriminator before repairing Frank code.

coordination.concurrent_nonduplicate_lane: Target PR #135 changes only Frank Deep Integrity runs-on from ubuntu-latest to [self-hosted, Linux, X64] to execute the unchanged suite and isolate transport from code failure.
coordination.law: Do not duplicate PR #135; consume its first executed discriminator when available.

negative_results_and_limits: GitHub decoded job-log endpoint returned BlobNotFound for the affected hosted jobs, so no unobserved stdout/stderr detail is promoted.
The exact root cause of hosted pre-step failure is UNKNOWN; this receipt classifies the evidence boundary, not the provider root cause.
Self-hosted identity conformance does not establish runtime/state lineage or full Frank v0.1 acceptance.
next_falsifier: Execute the unchanged Frank Deep Integrity suite on the accepted self-hosted Linux/X64 lane (PR #135). If steps execute, the first real failing test becomes the next Harness repair target; if the full suite passes, hosted red checks are transport-only for this observed case.

frank_v0_1_reentry.effect_on_acceptance: Improves evidence hygiene and prevents false regression attribution; no work package is promoted to PASS by this receipt.
